A young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a member of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Anakaret]]. When Anakaret became indebted to [[Aral tukor Viest]], the owner of a [[Aral tukor Viest's clearinghouse|clearinghouse]], she tried to buy out her freedom in Viest's death games. The young man became Anakaret's '''partner''' in the game. When the games were over, the man was happy that his captain had survived, and he affectionately hugged her.<ref name="Razor's Edge" />
